detailed_description:
The target video uses a photorealistic, live-action cinematic drama style featuring natural daylighting, subtle character micro-expressions, gentle camera pans, and warm emotional interactions set in <Environment 1>.
[Shot 1] The video opens with a medium shot showing <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> sitting side-by-side on wooden resting benches in <Environment 1>, with high red palace walls in the background. <Subject 1> exhales lightly and relaxes her shoulders, setting her steel sword beside her after an intense combat take.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, a medium close-up focuses on <Subject 2> as he turns toward <Subject 1> with an affectionate, concerned smile, picking up a steaming dark ceramic teacup from a small side table.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, <Subject 2> gently hands the teacup over to <Subject 1> and speaks in a warm, considerate tone, <d>[Chinese] 刚才那场打戏累不累？快喝口热茶润润嗓子。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, a close-up shot captures <Subject 1> looking up; her tired expression softens behind her glasses, a gentle, grateful smile appearing on her lips as her hands wrap around the warm ceramic cup, answering softly, <d>[Chinese] 稍微有点喘，不过动作特别过瘾，谢谢你的茶。</d>
[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, a two-shot medium angle shows <Subject 1> taking a slow sip of hot tea while steam rises, with <Subject 2> watching her warmly with a relaxed smile as dappled daylight falls across <Environment 1>.

overall_soundscape:
Faint steam hiss from the teacup, subtle fabric rustles, quiet courtyard breeze, ceramic teacup clinking, and soft spoken natural dialogue.
